definition: [ שָׂרַע ] verb extend (Arabic point directly at , also enter upon a path ( Frä 213 thinks originally divide , then stretch out, make straight ), projecting roof , long-nosed ( torto naso ᵑ9 Lev 21:18 ); Ethiopic dispose, arrange ; Sabean שרע arrangement, security Hom Chr 124 ; — but Aramaic explanation as mutilated Lev 21:18 ; Lev 22:23 PS 2744 , compare ᵐ5 ὠτότμητος ); — Qal Passive participle שָׂרוּעַ extended , i.e. too long (in a limb or member), of man Lev 21:18 , beast Lev 22:23 (see II. חרם ). Hithpa`el stretch oneself: Infinitive construct הִשְׂתָּרֵעַ Isa 28:20 (see מַצַּע p. 427:a). שַׂרְעַפִּים see below שׂעף .
